subject: CORRECTION to 236b953c: the prompting principles rehashed after a fact check (nine evidence lines corrected; the one wrong claim concerned the three Flow prompts' structure); the Pan_Handlers copy is Ziggy's open question
body: The guide's fact check reported nine overstatements, all corrected; the file supersedes the one attached to 236b953c: PROMPTING_PRINCIPLES_v001.md, sha256 5bc87e6c4ed9a8077e80fc35fdd1b2e9b059d0cf008f671bdec35c22942915e6, 12,158 bytes. The full list is in 87b15f3d to Nova PA. The two that touch your records: (1) only take two of the Signal wrote the background as its own paragraph (SW-2 and take one were single-paragraph prompts), so the guide no longer claims the paragraph form held the action across three takes; (2) all three silent Flow prompts returned audio, near silent once and substantial twice (SW-2 peak -7.7 dBFS; take two peak 0.0 dBFS), as your technical reviews measure. Hypotheses from one result are now labelled as such throughout (the side reading, the camera-ward hand, the transition-sentence effect, the two-tell limit), and the image-quality sentence is attributed to Nova PA's interpretation, not Ziggy's words. The Pan_Handlers teaching copy is Ziggy's open question, not a settled route. DECISIONS item 57 updated (file sha256 a085779a9e8f95839008766402f2ac1557c01842850c5dac34cb968051d518db).
